correctness.rationale: For every t>0, all five geometric edge-cost classes are exact. The antipodal-pair witness has cost 2E and parity tetrahedron witness has cost min(4D,2C+2D). The explicit certificate gives one feasible tour per 32 symmetry orbit representatives in each regime, and expresses the difference from a chosen witness cost as a nonnegative rational sum of analytically proved inequalities. A separate standard-library replay confirms every one of 64 vector identities and all 247 cases without numerical sampling. Every nonwinner orbit has a strictly positive inequality coefficient on the open t-domain. The two transition equations have unique solutions by monotonicity; no off-corner claim is made.

value.rationale: The specific geometry is a natural one-parameter anisotropic deformation of the cube configuration singled out by current power-TSP questions. The theorem gives a complete sharp worst-corner tour invariant for every prism aspect ratio, two nontrivial analytically specified thresholds, and a reentrant transition between antipodal-pair and four-vertex parity-tetrahedron minimax configurations, a structural feature absent from the previously known symmetric case. It is a complete natural classification rather than a sampled finite table.
